name: Red Neutralizer
desc: A basic alchemical solution. Even novice alchemists can easily synthesize it to test their skills, but it requires precision to extract its full power. Red Neutralizer has an affinity to fire.

eff.name: Synthesis: Fire Bonus
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] and quality by [Lv. x 1] when this ingredient and its slot have matching fire elements.

eff.name: Element Resonance - Fire
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] when used as an ingredient for a fire element synthesized item.
